facts.where: section on benchmarks and metrics
facts.quote: VulnGym we use the benchmark’s metrics and matching criterion: two locations match if they share a normalized repository-relative path and lie within k = 5 k{=}5 lines, and an entry is hit only if both its EP and CO match. T1 reports advisory recall (AR), entry recall (ER) and edit similarity (ES) of the trace over hit entries; T2–T4 report recall and precision of the requested component.
